note: Every dataset ASTRA has actually loaded is registered here. Datasets that a later build slice will vendor are not listed until they exist on disk, so this file never claims data the system does not hold.

datasets.name: ASTRA model configuration
datasets.processing: Weights, thresholds and phase policy constants authored for this prototype; published humanitarian norms within it carry their own citation.
datasets.notes: Values marked DEMO_CONFIG are ASTRA's analytical choices, not government rules or statutory thresholds.

datasets.name: Alaknanda valley study area definition
datasets.processing: Bounding box chosen over the Alaknanda corridor between Karnaprayag and Joshimath, Chamoli district, to frame all layers and fixtures.
datasets.notes: The corridor is real geography. No settlement inside it is classified by ASTRA using its real name or real population.
